$comment: Ticket 16: the identity registries, fetched whole rather than filtered to the names one crawl happened to use. Ticket 10's registry payloads answered only for the strings its ten events named, so every new event needed another identity pass; a wholesale read removes that dependency and makes the unresolved report mean 'the wiki has no row', not 'nobody fetched one'. Pages are offset queries because a single response is capped at its limit (measured: Esports World Cup 2026's player rows came back at exactly the 2000 limit, so that query is continued at offset 2000 here).
